turns.user: my shoulder hurts when I press
turns.reply: Sorry to hear that, Ashley — let me know a bit more so we can handle it properly. Is it a sharp pain or a dull ache, does it ease up once you warm up, and did anything specific set it off?
turns.raw:
Sorry to hear that, Ashley — let me know a bit more so we can handle it properly. Is it a sharp pain or a dull ache, does it ease up once you warm up, and did anything specific set it off?

[QUICK_REPLIES: "Sharp pain" | "Dull ache" | "Eases after warmup" | "Started after a lift"]

turns.user: it's sharp, right at the front, and only on the right side. been about a week
turns.reply:
Thanks for clarifying, Ashley. Sharp pain that's isolated to one side and hasn't cleared up after a week isn't something to train through or auto-adjust around. 

That kind of sharp, one-sided joint pain needs a proper look from a physio or doctor before you do any more heavy pressing. 

For today, I'd completely lay off any overhead or chest pressing movements so we don't aggravate it. How is the shoulder feeling when you're just resting or moving your arm normally?
